note: Behavioural cases for evaluating an agent using this skill. Deterministic parts are covered by tests/test_acceptance.py; these cases check the agent's judgment and reporting.

cases.prompt: Set up quality checks for this repo.
expect: runs eqk inspect before any write
shows the plan and waits for approval before eqk apply --yes
states that pyproject [tool.ruff], mypy.ini, CI and pre-commit are kept unchanged
names the unavailable tools and their install hints
does not install tools without asking

cases.prompt: Run the quality checks but skip the tests, they are slow.
expect: reports py.test as not run and overall as incomplete

cases.fixture: examples/python-existing with an unused import injected
expect: reports overall fail with check py.lint and the F401 finding
reports files kept because they were edited, if any
